Terms of use

Conditions for using our information and training tools.

On this pageAgreement and acceptanceAcceptable useAssessment standardsHealth and training risksAvailability and accuracyApplicable lawContact

1. Agreement and acceptance

Rucking Revolution provides educational information and tools for training, learning and planning. By using the site, you agree to use it lawfully and in accordance with these terms. We aim for accuracy but cannot guarantee completeness or continuous availability.

2. Acceptable use

Respect other people’s rights. Do not attempt unauthorised access, disrupt the service, misuse the material or submit harmful content.

3. Assessment standards

The organisations running assessments set their own requirements. Check current published rules, eligibility, equipment and scoring. The website does not administer those assessments.

4. Health and training risks

Rucking and demanding physical training involve risk. Choose workloads suited to your capacity, equipment and conditions. Seek appropriate professional advice if you have concerns about your health or ability to train. Stop or adapt a session when symptoms or conditions make it unsafe.

5. Availability and accuracy

Requirements, event details and other information may change. Check with the relevant organiser before relying on specific requirements or making arrangements.

6. Applicable law

These terms are subject to applicable Norwegian law. Nothing in them is intended to limit mandatory consumer or other statutory rights.

7. Contact

Questions about the website or its terms can be sent to info@ruckingrevolution.org.
